name: Mithralda — warm earthy medieval palette
note: Canonical palette-by-role for the Stage-1 vertical slice. Single source of truth for both the runtime renderer (game.js COL{}) and the asset-generation pipeline. Organized by READABILITY ROLE per design/STYLE_FORMULA.md, not as one flat gamma: environment recedes, actors pop, signal hues are reserved for hazards/pickups.

environment._desc: Ground/terrain tiles. Muted, low-saturation so actors read on top. base/light/dark = flat/highlight/shadow per tile.

actors._desc: Player classes + NPCs/enemies. Saturated enough to CONTRAST the environment. Shared parts (skin/blade/leather) keep the cast coherent; per-class body/cape/accent give identity.

signal._desc: Reserved hues for combat/hazards/pickups — must NOT appear on terrain or actors so the eye reads them instantly. One distinct glow per channel.

ui._desc: Frames, panels, text. Worn wood-and-stone medieval framing over a near-black field.
